parents.course: Interdisciplinary Approaches to Social Justice (Social Science)

ns2:section.sectionText: IASIS: Social Justice, Inequality & the Media. Students in this course gain critical media literacy skills through exploring contemporary social justice issues in the media ranging from Black Lives Matter to sexual assault on college campuses to immigration politics among other topics. The course applies the knowledge learned in the course to the UIUC campus through campus organizations impacted by these contemporary social justice issues. Throughout the semester students will work with these organizations to develop digital media projects that help to raise Campus awareness or work to engage students in Campus advocacy.�
